title: Follow-up loop must skip ticks while a push would eject the PR from the Trunk merge queue
answers: Why does the PostHog Code agent push to a PR that is in the merge queue?
Agent CI follow-up kicked my enqueued PR out of the Trunk queue
How does the PR follow-up loop decide to skip when the PR is queued?
body:
Any decision site in the PR follow-up loop must skip (CIFollowUpDecision.SKIP) when `merge_queue_push_would_eject` is true, because a follow-up push ejects the PR from the Trunk queue and restarts PRs testing behind it.
Enforced at three sites: `_should_run_babysit_follow_up` and `_should_run_ci_follow_up` in products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/workflow.py, and `_should_run_ci_follow_up` in products/tasks/backend/temporal/task_management/workflow.py. A new decision site needs the same gate.
The flag comes from `merge_queue_push_would_eject()` in process_task/activities/get_pr_context.py, carried on `GetPrContextOutput` and on `PRSnapshot` (babysit_pr/snapshot.py) via `get_pr_babysit_snapshot.py`.
Use the narrow "push would eject" state (queued/testing/passed/pending-failure/UNKNOWN), NOT "submitted". A submitted PR waiting on branch protection is not held, or it deadlocks: Trunk waits for green checks and the agent waits for Trunk.
On a skipped babysit tick do not touch `_babysit_journal`, so the same feedback is re-delivered after the PR leaves the queue.
applies: products/tasks Temporal PR follow-up (babysit and legacy CI follow-up) workflows
